test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 21 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ​The Government of India imposed an Agriculture and Infrastructure Development Cess of __________ per litre on petrol through Union Budget 2021-22.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs. 2.5.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **According to the Budget for 2021-22, a Rs 2.5 per liter Agriculture and Infrastructure Development Cess has been imposed on petrol and Rs 4 on diesel.**
 
• **Other items on which cess has been imposed as per Budget 2021-22:**
 
 
• 30 percent agriculture infra cess on **Kabuli chana.**
 
• 50 percent on **Bengal gram/chickpeas.**
 
• 10 percent on** peas.**
 
• 20 percent on **lentils (masoor).**
 
• 5 percent on **cotton.**
 
• 2.5 percent imposed on** gold, silver, and dore bars.**
 
• 35 percent imposed on **apples.**
 
• 5 percent on **specified fertilizer.**
 
• 1.5 percent on **coal, lignite, and peat.**
 
• 100 percent agriculture infra cess on alcoholic beverages. 
 
• 17.5 percent has been imposed on** crude palm oil.**
 
• 20 percent have also been imposed on **crude soyabean.​**
